mechanism: Omeprazole may increase betamethasone levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and reduced gastric acid-dependent absorption effects, while corticosteroids can increase omeprazole metabolism via CYP1A2 induction.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, adrenal suppression); adjust betamethasone dose if necessary and use PPI at lowest effective dose.
